# examples

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/examples"
```

<a name="ErrNoPresetSource"></a>ErrNoPresetSource is returned when WithExamples was given a nil Examples.

```go
var ErrNoPresetSource = errors.New("docgen: WithExamples requires a non-nil Examples")
```

<a name="Emit"></a>
## func [Emit](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/examples/examples.go#L20>)

```go
func Emit(src Source, dir string, titles map[string]string) ([]spec.GeneratedFile, error)
```

Emit writes one page per preset field listed in titles, holding the YAML of every preset that field exposes. The page is named after the lowercased title, so it matches the reference page for the same type.

<a name="Source"></a>
## type [Source](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/examples/examples.go#L71-L75>)

Source supplies the preset snippets an example page is built from. Declared here rather than imported, so any package whose preset source has this shape satisfies it without either side knowing the other.

```go
type Source interface {
    ListFields() []string
    ListPresets(field string) []string
    PresetYAML(field, name string) (string, error)
}
```
